decode_only.name: leading whitespace and a trailing newline are tolerated
blank lines between the marker and the body
not a device message at all
a marker that is not at the start is chat text
unknown op passes through (the host answers unsupported)
another protocol version still decodes (the host answers unsupported)
a body that is not JSON
two spaces between fields do not match the grammar

task_args.name: numbers clamped from below and above
an empty done_when is no done_when

progress.name: only what is allowed gets through
a long line is cut to 140 characters
a long line of emoji is cut by characters
of below 1 is dropped, waiting must be a boolean

task_result.name: a clean result passes through unchanged
extra fields never travel (output, screenshots, anything else)
summary 500, what 200, task_id 64 are the caps
caps count characters: emoji are cut by code point
bad step rows are dropped, a missing n is its place in the list
bad types fall back: no summary, no checked, no steps, no counts
checked.ok must be a boolean; what may be missing
whole numbers: 2.0 is whole, 2.5 is not
